Account Manager
Wing is on the exciting mission of redefining the future of work for companies worldwide! We are looking to be the one-stop shop for companies that are looking to build world-class teams & place their operations on autopilot.
And we’re looking for an Account Manager to start immediately!
Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Oversee and manage VAs during the assigned working hours.
Ensure daily sourcing goals are being reached.
Assist with sourcing activities as needed.
Help standardize and establish procedures for the department.
Support the team in maintaining consistent processes and achieving department goals.
Qualifications:
• At least 2 years of management experience; 4 years preferred
• E-commerce background is preferred but not required
• Good English communication skills
• Strong leadership and organizational skills
• Ability to oversee VAs and ensure daily goals are met
• Ability to assist with sourcing as needed
• Ability to help standardize and improve department processes
Technical Requirements:
• USB Headset with Noise Cancellation feature
• Working Webcam
• Computer with at least 1.8 GHz processor and at least 4GB RAM
• Main Internet Service Speed: at least 25 Mbps cable connection
• Backup Internet Service Speed: at least 10 Mbps
Benefits:
• Health Insurance (HMO)
• Performance Incentives
• Job Security and Stability
• Paid Training
• Inclusive Culture
• Upskilling Opportunities
• 100% Work-From-Home
• Exceptionally Supportive Team
• Opportunities for Career Growth
• Fun Work Environment
• Holiday & Overtime Pay
Schedule: 4:00 PM – 12:00 AM EST
Location: This is a remote job
Salary Package:
• PHP 39,000.00 – PHP 42,000.00
Please note:
• Only qualified candidates will be invited to take the assessment & scheduled for an interview.
• We have other vacancies that might interest your friends & colleagues. They can check us out at our Jobs Website.

Compensation
PHP 39,000–42,000 per month
